definitions.full: H5910. Akko עַכּוֺ proper name, of a location Ακχω , Acco , in Asher, Judg 1:31 , + Josh 19:30 (P), reading ׳ע for עֻמָּה ᵑ0 , Di Kau Benn Ency. Bib., after ᵐ5 Manuscripts; a seaport north of Carmel (= Acre, Ptolemais), modern `Akka , compare Buhl Geogr. 228 (Egyptian ±A-ka , Ἀκη WMM As.u.Eur.181 ; Assyrian Akkû , COT Gloss , Tel Amarna Ak-ka ). עכן (√ of following; meaning unknown).
